tasks.title: Cell Culture and Maintenance
tasks.description: Neural stem cells and P19 cells are cultured in specific media conditions to ensure optimal growth and maintenance.
tasks.goal: to maintain healthy cell cultures

tasks.title: Neuronal Differentiation
tasks.description: Cells are transferred to priming and differentiation media to induce neuronal differentiation over a specified period.
tasks.goal: to differentiate neural stem cells into neurons

tasks.title: Cell Transfection
tasks.description: Cells are transfected with plasmids using Lipofectamine 2000 to introduce genetic material for further analysis.
tasks.goal: to introduce plasmids into target cells

tasks.title: RNA Extraction and qRT-PCR
tasks.description: Total RNA is extracted from cells, converted to cDNA, and analyzed using quantitative real-time PCR to measure gene expression.
tasks.goal: to quantify gene expression levels

tasks.title: Western Blotting
tasks.description: Proteins are extracted from cells, separated by SDS-PAGE, and transferred to membranes for detection using specific antibodies.
tasks.goal: to analyze protein expression levels

tasks.title: Cellular Fractionation
tasks.description: Cells are fractionated into cytoplasmic, nuclear, and chromatin fractions for detailed protein analysis.
tasks.goal: to isolate different cellular compartments for analysis

tasks.title: Agarose-TUBEs Pull Down
tasks.description: Ubiquitylated proteins are pulled down from cell lysates using Agarose-TUBEs for further analysis.
tasks.goal: to isolate ubiquitylated proteins

tasks.title: Protein Stability Assay
tasks.description: Cells are treated with cycloheximide to assess the stability of specific proteins over time.
tasks.goal: to determine protein half-lives

tasks.title: Immunocytochemistry
tasks.description: Cells are fixed, permeabilized, and stained with antibodies to visualize specific proteins using fluorescence microscopy.
tasks.goal: to visualize protein localization in cells

tasks.title: Gene Reporter Assay
tasks.description: Cells are transfected with luciferase reporter constructs and analyzed for luciferase activity to assess gene expression.
tasks.goal: to measure transcriptional activity of specific genes

tasks.title: Ethics Approval
tasks.description: Obtain approval for the use of human specimens from the relevant ethics board.
tasks.goal: to ensure ethical compliance for human specimen use

tasks.title: Collection of Human Biopsies
tasks.description: Collect postmortem biopsy specimens from COVID-19 and non-COVID-19 patients, ensuring proper matching of controls.
tasks.goal: to gather appropriate tissue samples for analysis

tasks.title: Hematology and Biochemistry Analysis
tasks.description: Retrospectively analyze the last available blood samples from COVID-19 patients for hematology and biochemistry.
tasks.goal: to assess hematological and biochemical parameters of patients

tasks.title: Histopathological Characterization
tasks.description: Prepare and analyze formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded lung tissue sections for histological examination.
tasks.goal: to characterize lung pathology in COVID-19 patients

tasks.title: Immunofluorescence Staining
tasks.description: Perform immunofluorescence staining on lung tissue sections to identify NETs using specific antibodies.
tasks.goal: to visualize NETs in lung tissues

tasks.title: Microscopy Imaging
tasks.description: Acquire images of stained lung sections using fluorescence microscopy and confocal microscopy.
key_materials: Zeiss LSM 880 Airyscan Elyra S.1. confocal microscope
tasks.goal: to capture and analyze fluorescence images of lung sections

tasks.title: Quantification of NET Volume
tasks.description: Analyze images to quantify the volume of NETs in lung tissue using Imaris software.
tasks.goal: to quantify NET presence in lung tissues

tasks.title: Scanning of Lung Sections
tasks.description: Scan entire lung sections using a Nanozoomer system to identify NET-infiltrating areas.
tasks.goal: to assess NET distribution across lung sections

tasks.title: Statistical Analysis
tasks.description: Perform statistical analysis on the collected data to determine significance of findings.
tasks.goal: to analyze data for statistical significance

tasks.title: Germination and Growth of Tomato Plants
tasks.description: Tomato seeds are germinated in vermiculite and grown under controlled environmental conditions for four weeks, with regular irrigation using distilled water and nutrient solutions.
tasks.goal: to establish healthy tomato plants for experimentation

tasks.title: Nutrient Treatment Application
tasks.description: Plants are treated with different nutrient solutions, including control and nitrogen-deficient solutions, to assess their effects on plant growth and response.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the impact of nutrient variations on plant health

tasks.title: Application of Chemical Inhibitors
tasks.description: PA biosynthesis inhibitors DFMA and DFMO are prepared and applied to the plants prior to pathogen inoculation to study their effects on plant responses.
tasks.goal: to investigate the role of polyamine biosynthesis in plant defense

tasks.title: Pathogen Inoculation
tasks.description: Tomato plants are inoculated with Pseudomonas syringae and Botrytis cinerea to assess disease susceptibility and plant responses.
tasks.goal: to evaluate plant resistance to pathogens

tasks.title: Disease Assessment
tasks.description: The disease rate is scored by measuring the percentage of dark-brown spots on leaves at specified time points post-inoculation.
tasks.goal: to quantify disease severity in treated plants

tasks.title: Biomass and Chlorophyll Measurement
tasks.description: Dried plant tissues are weighed to determine biomass, and chlorophyll content is measured using a chlorophyll meter to assess plant health.
tasks.goal: to assess the physiological status of the plants

tasks.title: H2O2 Accumulation Analysis
tasks.description: Leaf samples are collected and processed to quantify H2O2 levels using the xylenol orange method, providing insights into oxidative stress responses.
tasks.goal: to measure oxidative stress in plants

tasks.title: Gene Expression Analysis
tasks.description: RNA is extracted from leaf tissues and analyzed using qRT-PCR to evaluate the expression of specific genes related to plant responses.
tasks.goal: to determine gene expression changes in response to treatments

tasks.title: Stomatal Aperture Measurement
tasks.description: Stomatal apertures are analyzed using microscopy to assess the physiological responses of plants to pathogen inoculation.
tasks.goal: to evaluate stomatal behavior in response to infection

tasks.title: Chromatographic Analysis of Hormones
tasks.description: Hormonal levels in plant tissues are analyzed using HPLC to investigate the effects of treatments on hormone profiles.
tasks.goal: to analyze hormonal changes in response to treatments

tasks.title: Statistical Analysis of Data
tasks.description: Data from experiments are statistically analyzed using ANOVA to determine the significance of results across different treatments.
tasks.goal: to validate experimental results through statistical methods

tasks.title: Preparation of Bacterial Strains
tasks.description: Obtain and prepare Salmonella strains and plasmids, including the replacement of the fliG gene with pHluorin(M153R)-fliG using homologous recombination.
tasks.goal: to prepare genetically modified bacterial strains

tasks.title: DNA Manipulations
tasks.description: Perform DNA manipulations including sequencing reactions using BigDye v3.1 and analyze the results with a genetic analyzer.
tasks.goal: to manipulate and analyze DNA sequences

tasks.title: Flagellar Protein Export Assay
tasks.description: Grow Salmonella cells, wash them, and perform a flagellar protein export assay by analyzing cell pellets and culture supernatants.
tasks.goal: to assess flagellar protein export

tasks.title: Purification of Proteins
tasks.description: Purify pHluorin(M153R) and pHluorin(M153R)-FliG proteins from bacterial cultures using affinity chromatography.
tasks.goal: to obtain purified proteins for further analysis

tasks.title: Fluorescence Microscopy
tasks.description: Observe Salmonella cells expressing fluorescent proteins using a custom-built fluorescence microscope.
tasks.goal: to visualize fluorescently labeled cells

tasks.title: Cytoplasmic pH Measurement
tasks.description: Determine the bulk and local cytoplasmic pH of Salmonella cells using fluorescence intensity ratios from captured images.
tasks.goal: to measure cytoplasmic pH levels

tasks.title: Local pH Determination Around Export Apparatus
tasks.description: Capture fluorescence images to determine the local pH around the export apparatus using intensity ratios.
tasks.goal: to assess local pH near the export apparatus

tasks.title: Cryo-EM Sample Preparation
tasks.description: Prepare hook-basal bodies from Salmonella strains and apply them to grids for cryo-EM imaging.
tasks.goal: to prepare samples for cryo-electron microscopy

tasks.title: Cryo-EM Imaging and Processing
tasks.description: Collect cryo-EM images and process them to analyze the structures of hook-basal bodies.
tasks.goal: to analyze cryo-EM images for structural insights

tasks.title: Electron Cryotomography
tasks.description: Prepare minicells and collect images at liquid-nitrogen temperature for electron cryotomography analysis.
tasks.goal: to perform 3D reconstructions of minicell structures

tasks.title: Isolation of CD8+ T cells
tasks.description: Enriched CD8+ T cells are isolated from individual A for further experimentation.
key_materials: CD8+ T cells from individual A
tasks.goal: to obtain a sufficient number of CD8+ T cells for culture

tasks.title: Stimulation of CD8+ T cells
tasks.description: Isolated CD8+ T cells are stimulated with B-APCs and common gamma chain cytokines in culture plates.
tasks.goal: to expand CD8+ T cells and induce CD28- phenotype

tasks.title: Incubation of T cells
tasks.description: The stimulated CD8+ T cells are incubated for 9 days to allow for expansion and differentiation.
tasks.goal: to promote the growth and functional maturation of CD8+ T cells

tasks.title: Enrichment of CD8+ CD28- T cells
tasks.description: After incubation, the CD8+ CD28- T cells are enriched from the culture.
tasks.goal: to isolate the specific T cell subset for functional assays

tasks.title: Coculture with CD4+ T cells
tasks.description: CFSE-labeled CD4+ T cells are cocultured with B-APCs or I-APCs in the presence or absence of CD8+ CD28- T cells.
tasks.goal: to assess the suppressive effect of CD8+ CD28- T cells on CD4+ T cell proliferation

tasks.title: Proliferation assessment
tasks.description: The proliferation of CD4+ T cells is measured using CFSE dilution assay after 7 and 11 days of coculture.
tasks.goal: to quantify the suppressive activity of CD8+ CD28- T cells

tasks.title: In vivo administration of T cells
tasks.description: A mixture of human cells, including CD8+ CD28- T cells, is administered to NOG mice via intraperitoneal injection.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the in vivo suppressive capacity of CD8+ CD28- T cells

tasks.title: Flow cytometry analysis
tasks.description: After 11 days, mice are sacrificed and human CD4+ T cells in the spleen are analyzed by flow cytometry.
tasks.goal: to determine the effect of CD8+ CD28- T cells on CD4+ T cell populations in vivo

tasks.title: Immunohistochemistry
tasks.description: Immunohistochemical analysis is performed on spleen samples to visualize the presence of human T cells.
tasks.goal: to assess the localization and survival of transferred T cells in the spleen

tasks.goal: to evaluate gene expression levels

tasks.title: Genetic Mapping of R-BPMV Gene
tasks.description: The R-BPMV resistance gene is mapped using segregation analysis and linkage mapping software.
tasks.goal: to determine the genetic location of the R-BPMV gene

tasks.description: Transfect 293T cells with viral constructs to produce viral vectors, then harvest and store the supernatant.

tasks.title: Neutralization Assays with Pseudotype Virus
tasks.description: Conduct neutralization assays using pseudotyped MLV(SARS) virions and patient serum samples to assess neutralization titers.
tasks.goal: to measure neutralizing antibody titers against pseudotyped viruses

tasks.title: Plant Cross and Mutant Generation
tasks.description: Cross ecotypes with short and long telomeres to generate stn1 mutants and analyze their phenotypes across generations.

tasks.title: Phenotypic Analysis of Mutants
tasks.description: Categorize the phenotypes of stn1 mutants from wild-type looking to terminally stunted plants based on growth defects.
tasks.goal: to assess the severity of growth defects in stn1 mutants

tasks.title: Telomere Length Measurement
tasks.description: Measure telomere length in stn1 mutants using dot blot hybridization and TRF analysis.
tasks.goal: to quantify telomere length in stn1 mutants

tasks.title: EXO1 Mutant Analysis
tasks.description: Generate and analyze exo1 stn1 double mutants to assess the impact of EXO1 on telomere dysfunction.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the role of EXO1 in telomere maintenance

tasks.title: G-Overhang Size Assessment
tasks.description: Compare G-overhang sizes in stn1 and exo1 stn1 mutants using in gel hybridization techniques.
tasks.goal: to determine the effect of STN1 and EXO1 on G-overhangs

tasks.title: Telomerase Activity Analysis
tasks.description: Generate telomerase-null stn1 mutants and assess their growth defects and telomere length.
tasks.goal: to investigate the contribution of telomerase to telomere maintenance

tasks.title: DNA Polymerase α Mutant Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze the phenotypes of DNA polymerase α mutants and their similarities to stn1 mutants.
tasks.goal: to compare telomere-related phenotypes between stn1 and DNA polymerase α mutants

tasks.title: Flow Cytometry for DNA Content Measurement

tasks.title: Genomic DNA Sequencing
tasks.description: Perform Illumina sequencing on sorted nuclei to analyze genomic regions affected by STN1 deficiency.
tasks.goal: to identify genomic regions impacted by STN1 dysfunction

tasks.title: Data Collection from TCGA
tasks.description: Collect mRNA levels of MCU and related proteins from the TCGA breast cancer dataset to analyze their correlation with tumor progression.
tasks.goal: to analyze MCU expression in relation to tumor progression

tasks.title: Cell Line Selection and Treatment
tasks.description: Select three human metastatic TNBC cell lines and treat them with specific agonists to induce cytosolic Ca2+ transients.
tasks.goal: to induce Ca2+ transients for subsequent analysis

tasks.title: MCU Silencing via siRNA
tasks.description: Use short-interfering RNA (siRNA) to inhibit MCU expression in selected TNBC cell lines and assess the impact on mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the role of MCU in mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake

tasks.title: Wound Healing Migration Assay
tasks.description: Perform a wound healing migration assay to assess the impact of MCU silencing on cell motility in TNBC cell lines.
tasks.goal: to measure cell migration affected by MCU silencing

tasks.title: Spheroid Formation Assay
tasks.description: Conduct an in vitro spheroid formation assay to evaluate the invasion potential of MCU-silenced TNBC cells.
tasks.goal: to assess the invasive capacity of TNBC cells

tasks.title: In Vivo Tumor Analysis
tasks.description: Inject MCU-deleted MDA-MB-231 cells into SCID mice and monitor tumor growth, lymph node infiltration, and metastasis formation.
tasks.goal: to investigate the effects of MCU deletion on tumor progression in vivo

tasks.title: Measurement of Cellular Metabolism
tasks.description: Measure cellular and mitochondrial NADH and NADPH levels, as well as ATP production, to assess the impact of MCU downregulation on redox metabolism.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the metabolic consequences of MCU silencing

tasks.title: ROS Production Assessment
tasks.description: Measure mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels to determine the effect of MCU silencing on ROS production.
tasks.goal: to analyze the role of mitochondrial ROS in cell migration

tasks.title: HIF-1α Protein Level Analysis
tasks.description: Investigate the effect of MCU silencing on HIF-1α protein levels and transcription in TNBC cells.
tasks.goal: to understand the regulatory role of MCU on HIF-1α

tasks.title: Cell Preparation and Staining
tasks.description: Isolate planarian cells and stain them with Hoechst and MTG to assess mitochondrial mass.

tasks.title: Flow Cytometry Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze stained cells using flow cytometry to identify distinct populations based on nuclear content and mitochondrial mass.
tasks.goal: to categorize cells into X1, X2, and Xins populations

tasks.description: Treat cells with Verapamil to assess the impact of efflux pump inhibition on MTG fluorescence.
tasks.goal: to determine if low MTG intensity is due to dye efflux

tasks.title: Immunostaining for PIWI-1
tasks.description: Perform immunostaining using a PIWI-1 antibody to identify stem cell populations within X1 and X2 cells.

tasks.title: RNA Sequencing
tasks.description: Conduct RNA sequencing on X1-MTG Low and X1-MTG High populations to analyze gene expression differences.
tasks.goal: to identify differentially expressed genes related to stemness and differentiation

tasks.title: Transplantation Assays
tasks.description: Transplant sorted cell populations into lethally irradiated planarians to assess their pluripotency and survival.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the stem cell activity of different mitochondrial mass populations

tasks.title: Mitochondrial Activity Assessment
tasks.description: Simultaneously stain cells with MTG and MitoTracker Orange to evaluate mitochondrial potential.
tasks.goal: to correlate mitochondrial content with activity in stem cells

tasks.title: FCCP Treatment and Analysis
tasks.description: Treat neoblasts with FCCP to investigate the effects on differentiation and mitochondrial activity.
tasks.goal: to understand the role of mitochondrial activity in stem cell differentiation

tasks.title: siRNA Preparation
tasks.description: Dispense siRNA SMARTpools into 384-well plates and store at -80°C.
tasks.goal: to prepare siRNA for transfection

tasks.title: Transfection Complex Formation
tasks.description: Thaw plates and add transfection reagent to form complexes before adding cells.
tasks.goal: to form transfection complexes

tasks.title: Cell Seeding
tasks.description: Wash, trypsinize, and count HeLa cells before seeding them into the assay plates.
tasks.goal: to seed cells for transfection

tasks.title: Incubation Post-Transfection
tasks.description: Incubate the transfected cells for 48 hours in a humidified incubator.
tasks.goal: to allow transfection to occur

tasks.title: Virus Infection
tasks.description: Remove media and add virus or media containing penicillin-streptomycin to the wells.
tasks.goal: to infect cells with virus

tasks.title: Replication Monitoring
tasks.description: Monitor virus replication by measuring eGFP fluorescence at specified time points.
tasks.goal: to assess virus replication

tasks.title: Cell Viability Assay
tasks.description: Add CellTiter Blue reagent to assess cytotoxicity of siRNAs and measure fluorescence.
tasks.goal: to evaluate cell viability

tasks.title: Yeast Two-Hybrid Screening
tasks.description: Clone HSV-1 proteins into bait vector and screen against prey library for interactions.
tasks.goal: to identify protein interactions

tasks.title: Bioinformatic Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze protein-protein interactions and calculate betweenness centrality from interaction data.
tasks.goal: to connect interactions to a protein network

tasks.title: siRNA Deconvolution
tasks.description: Validate siRNA effects by deconvoluting SMARTpools and assessing replication slopes.
tasks.goal: to confirm siRNA effects on replication

tasks.title: qPCR for siRNA Knockdown
tasks.description: Extract RNA from transfected cells and quantify mRNA levels using qPCR.
tasks.goal: to measure gene knockdown efficiency

tasks.title: LUMIER Assay for Protein Interaction Validation
tasks.description: Transfect HEK293 cells with hybrid proteins and perform pull-down assays to validate interactions.
tasks.goal: to validate protein interactions

tasks.title: Viral Vector Selection
tasks.description: Select appropriate viral vectors for gene delivery, focusing on AAV serotype 6 for its infectivity in mouse and human ES cells.
tasks.goal: to choose the most effective viral vector for the experiment

tasks.title: Embryo Preparation
tasks.description: Prepare pronuclear-stage mouse embryos for microinjection by ensuring they are viable and ready for viral vector introduction.
tasks.goal: to ensure embryos are suitable for viral infection

tasks.title: Microinjection of Viral Vectors
tasks.description: Microinject selected viral vectors encoding EGFP into the perivitelline space of the prepared embryos.
tasks.goal: to deliver viral vectors into embryos for gene expression

tasks.title: Confirmation of Transgene Expression
tasks.description: Assess the expression of EGFP in embryos at the morula/blastocyst stage using fluorescence microscopy.
tasks.goal: to verify successful transgene expression in embryos

tasks.title: Electroporation of Cas9-RNP
tasks.description: Introduce Cas9-RNP into pronuclear-stage embryos via electroporation to facilitate gene editing.
tasks.goal: to prepare embryos for CRISPR/Cas9-mediated gene editing

tasks.title: Infection with AAV Vector
tasks.description: Infect embryos with self-complementary AAV vectors containing donor DNA after electroporation.
tasks.goal: to deliver donor DNA for gene knockin

tasks.title: Assessment of Knockin Efficiency
tasks.description: Evaluate the efficiency of knockin at the Rosa26 locus by analyzing offspring and their genotypes.
tasks.goal: to determine the success rate of gene knockin

tasks.title: Germline Transmission Confirmation
tasks.description: Confirm germline transmission by breeding knockin founders and analyzing the next generation offspring.
tasks.goal: to verify that the knockin allele is passed to the next generation

tasks.title: Phenotypic Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze the phenotypic outcomes of the gene editing, including any restoration of specific traits.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the functional impact of the gene editing on phenotype

tasks.title: Data Analysis and Interpretation
tasks.description: Analyze and interpret data from experiments, including transgene expression levels and knockin efficiency.
tasks.goal: to draw conclusions from the experimental results

tasks.goal: to produce high levels of target proteins for analysis

tasks.title: Co-immunoprecipitation
tasks.description: Isolate protein complexes from cell lysates using specific antibodies and analyze by Western blotting.
tasks.goal: to study protein-protein interactions

tasks.title: Chromatin Immunoprecipitation
tasks.description: Cross-link, lyse cells, and precipitate chromatin using specific antibodies to analyze protein-DNA interactions.
tasks.goal: to investigate protein binding to DNA

tasks.title: ChIP-seq Library Preparation
tasks.description: Prepare DNA sequencing libraries from ChIP-extracted DNA for high-throughput sequencing.
tasks.goal: to analyze chromatin interactions at a genomic scale

tasks.title: RNA Isolation and qPCR
tasks.description: Isolate RNA from cells and perform quantitative PCR to assess gene expression levels.
tasks.goal: to quantify gene expression changes

tasks.title: In vitro Translation
tasks.description: Use a coupled transcription/translation system to produce labeled proteins for binding assays.
tasks.goal: to generate proteins for functional assays

tasks.title: Data Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze experimental data using statistical software to determine significance and interpret results.
tasks.goal: to validate and interpret experimental findings

tasks.title: Gene Identification
tasks.description: Screen publicly available datasets for Arabidopsis genes with transcriptional signatures of CBGs or CCGs to identify novel regulators of chlorophyll biosynthesis and catabolism.
tasks.goal: to identify BCM1 as a regulator of chlorophyll metabolism

tasks.title: Immunoblot Analysis
tasks.description: Perform immunoblot analyses using BCM1 antiserum to determine the accumulation of BCM1 protein in various Arabidopsis tissues.
tasks.goal: to assess BCM1 protein levels in different tissues

tasks.title: Transient Expression in Protoplasts
tasks.description: Fuse BCM1 to yellow fluorescent protein (YFP) and express in Arabidopsis protoplasts to study its localization.
tasks.goal: to determine the chloroplast localization of BCM1

tasks.title: Characterization of Mutants
tasks.description: Characterize the chlorophyll biosynthesis status in bcm1 mutants and BCM1-overexpressing plants to assess the role of BCM1.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the impact of BCM1 on chlorophyll accumulation

tasks.title: ALA Synthesis Measurement
tasks.description: Measure the rates of ALA synthesis in bcm1 mutants and BCM1-OX plants to understand BCM1's role in the TBS pathway.
tasks.goal: to quantify ALA synthesis rates in different plant lines

tasks.title: Protein Level Analysis
tasks.description: Examine the expression of chlorophyll biosynthesis genes and steady-state levels of chlorophyll biosynthesis enzymes in bcm1 and BCM1-OX seedlings.
tasks.goal: to analyze the effects of BCM1 on chlorophyll biosynthesis proteins

tasks.title: Genetic Interaction Studies
tasks.description: Investigate the genetic interactions between bcm1 and MgCh mutants to elucidate the role of BCM1 in chlorophyll metabolism.
tasks.goal: to explore the genetic interactions affecting chlorophyll biosynthesis

tasks.title: Yeast Two-Hybrid Screening
tasks.description: Conduct yeast two-hybrid screening to identify potential protein partners of BCM1 involved in the TBS pathway.
tasks.goal: to discover interacting partners of BCM1

tasks.title: In Vitro MgCh Activity Assay
tasks.description: Perform in vitro assays to measure MgCh activity in the presence of BCM1 and its interacting partners.
tasks.goal: to assess the effect of BCM1 on MgCh activity

tasks.title: Chlorophyll Breakdown Analysis
tasks.description: Determine chlorophyll degradation rates in various Arabidopsis lines during dark-induced senescence to evaluate the role of BCM1 and BCM2.
tasks.goal: to analyze the impact of BCM1 and BCM2 on chlorophyll breakdown

tasks.title: Electron Microscopy of Chloroplasts
tasks.description: Conduct electron microscopy to examine the structural integrity of chloroplasts in different Arabidopsis lines during senescence.
tasks.goal: to visualize chloroplast structure during chlorophyll degradation

tasks.title: Immunofluorescence Analysis
tasks.description: Perform immunofluorescence staining to identify and quantify satellite cells expressing specific markers (PAX7, MYOD, Ki67, EdU).
tasks.goal: to analyze satellite cell activation and proliferation

tasks.title: Co-culture with Damaged Myofibers
tasks.description: Co-culture intact myofibers with mechanically damaged myofibers to study the direct effects of damaged myofibers on satellite cell activation.
tasks.goal: to investigate the influence of damaged myofibers on satellite cell behavior

tasks.title: Proteome Analysis
tasks.description: Conduct proteome analysis to identify metabolic enzymes that act as direct muscle-derived factors (DMDFs) influencing satellite cell activation.
tasks.goal: to identify proteins that stimulate satellite cell activation

tasks.title: Treat with Recombinant Proteins
tasks.description: Apply recombinant proteins identified as DMDFs to satellite cells in culture to assess their effects on cell cycle entry.
key_materials: recombinant proteins (AK-1, CK, GAPDH, PGAM-2, TPI)
tasks.goal: to determine the role of DMDFs in satellite cell activation

tasks.title: In Vivo Experimentation
tasks.description: Administer GAPDH recombinant protein into TA muscles of mice to evaluate its effect on satellite cell activation and proliferation during muscle regeneration.
tasks.goal: to assess the in vivo effects of DMDFs on satellite cells

tasks.title: Data Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze the data obtained from immunofluorescence and in vivo experiments to draw conclusions about satellite cell behavior.
tasks.goal: to interpret the results of the experiments

tasks.title: Obtain ethical approval
tasks.description: Secure ethical approval for the use of human tissue samples in the study.
tasks.goal: to ensure compliance with ethical standards

tasks.title: Perform laser micro-dissection
tasks.description: Use a Zeiss/PALM Microscope to isolate specific cell types from formalin-fixed/paraffin-embedded tissue samples.
tasks.goal: to isolate target cell populations for analysis

tasks.title: Culture and transfect cells
tasks.description: Obtain MCF7 and HB2 cell lines, and perform transfection to establish stable cell lines expressing GFP and luciferase.
tasks.goal: to generate modified cell lines for functional assays

tasks.title: Isolate primary fibroblasts
tasks.description: Isolate primary fibroblasts from breast surgical samples and immortalize them using hTERT retroviral transduction.
tasks.goal: to obtain a stable source of fibroblast cells

tasks.title: Conduct functional assays
tasks.description: Perform assays to evaluate cell viability, cell cycle, apoptosis, migration, and invasion.
tasks.goal: to assess the functional characteristics of the cell lines

tasks.title: Perform RNA extraction
tasks.description: Extract RNA from FFPE tissues and cell lines using specific isolation kits.
tasks.goal: to obtain high-quality RNA for downstream analyses

tasks.title: Conduct quantitative PCR
tasks.description: Perform qPCR analyses on extracted RNA to quantify gene expression levels.
tasks.goal: to measure gene expression levels in samples

tasks.title: Perform microarray analysis
tasks.description: Analyze miRNA expression using human miRNA v2 arrays and associated reagents.
tasks.goal: to profile miRNA expression in samples

tasks.title: Conduct protein mass spectrometry
tasks.description: Separate peptides from cell lysates using capillary liquid chromatography and analyze them by tandem mass spectrometry.
tasks.goal: to identify and quantify proteins in the samples

tasks.title: Perform statistical analyses
tasks.description: Analyze data using statistical software to determine significance and interpret results.
tasks.goal: to validate findings and assess statistical significance

tasks.title: Sequence Analysis of TDP43 Homologs
tasks.description: Compile and analyze a database of vertebrate TDP43 homologs to assess sequence diversity and conservation patterns.
tasks.goal: to decode the rules relating TDP43 phase behavior to its amino-acid sequence

tasks.title: Mutagenesis of TDP43 CTD
tasks.description: Engineer mutations in the TDP43 C-terminal domain (CTD) to alter phase properties and assess their effects on phase separation.
tasks.goal: to customize TDP43 phase properties

tasks.title: Expression of TDP43 RRM-GFP Reporter
tasks.description: Generate and express a TDP43 RRM-GFP fusion protein in cells to study phase separation dynamics.
tasks.goal: to create a reporter for studying TDP43 phase separation in live cells

tasks.title: Live-Cell Imaging and Analysis
tasks.description: Use live-cell imaging techniques to monitor the phase behavior of TDP43 RRM-GFP droplets in response to mutations.
tasks.goal: to quantitatively analyze TDP43 phase properties in living cells

tasks.title: Flow Cytometry for Splicing Assays
tasks.description: Develop a flow cytometry-compatible splicing reporter to measure TDP43-mediated exon skipping.
tasks.goal: to assess the splicing efficiency of TDP43 variants

tasks.title: RT-PCR for Splicing Analysis
tasks.description: Perform reverse transcription-PCR to analyze splicing intermediates and assess the function of TDP43 variants.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the impact of TDP43 mutations on splicing

tasks.title: In Vitro Phase Separation Assays
tasks.description: Purify full-length TDP43 variants and assess their phase separation behavior in vitro under different conditions.
tasks.goal: to validate findings from live-cell assays in vitro

tasks.title: Data Analysis and Interpretation
tasks.description: Analyze data from imaging, flow cytometry, and RT-PCR experiments to draw conclusions about TDP43 function and phase behavior.
tasks.goal: to interpret the effects of mutations on TDP43 function and phase separation

tasks.description: Culture various human and mouse cell lines in appropriate media under controlled conditions.

tasks.goal: to investigate the role of specific genes in cellular processes

tasks.title: Isolation of mRNA from Drosophila heads
tasks.description: Extract mRNA from the adult heads of TBPH-null and wild-type Drosophila for gene expression analysis.
tasks.goal: to analyze gene expression differences

tasks.title: Hybridization to GeneChip Arrays
tasks.description: Hybridize isolated mRNA to GeneChip Drosophila Genome 2.0 Arrays to assess gene expression profiles.
tasks.goal: to identify dysregulated transposons

tasks.title: Statistical analysis of microarray data
tasks.description: Perform statistical analysis on microarray data to identify significant changes in gene expression.
tasks.goal: to confirm dysregulation of transposons

tasks.title: Quantitative RT-PCR validation
tasks.description: Use quantitative RT-PCR to validate the expression levels of specific retrotransposons in TBPH-null and wild-type flies.
tasks.goal: to confirm microarray findings

tasks.title: Treatment with reverse transcriptase inhibitors
tasks.description: Administer nucleoside and non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors to TBPH-null flies to assess their effects on locomotive defects.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the role of retrotransposons in locomotion

tasks.title: Silencing gypsy expression
tasks.description: Utilize RNAi constructs to silence the expression of the gypsy retrotransposon in TBPH-null Drosophila.
tasks.goal: to assess the impact of gypsy on TBPH-null phenotypes

tasks.title: Analysis of synaptic growth and muscle innervation
tasks.description: Examine the effects of gypsy silencing on synaptic growth and muscle innervation in TBPH-null flies.
tasks.goal: to determine the role of gypsy in neuromuscular junctions

tasks.title: Assessment of siRNA machinery efficiency
tasks.description: Evaluate the efficiency of the siRNA machinery in TBPH-null versus wild-type flies using GFP reporter assays.
tasks.goal: to investigate the impact of TBPH on siRNA function

tasks.title: Dicer-2 expression analysis
tasks.description: Measure the expression levels of Dicer-2 and other siRNA machinery components in TBPH-null and wild-type flies using qRT-PCR.
tasks.goal: to understand the regulation of siRNA components by TBPH

tasks.title: Transgenic expression of Dicer-2
tasks.description: Cross transgenic flies expressing Dicer-2 with TBPH-null flies to assess the effects on locomotive behavior.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the rescue of locomotive defects

tasks.title: Therapeutic intervention with enoxacin
tasks.description: Treat TBPH-null larvae with enoxacin to assess its effects on locomotive capacities and motoneuron innervation.
tasks.goal: to explore potential therapeutic strategies for TBPH-related phenotypes

tasks.title: Animal Preparation and Surgery
tasks.description: Male albino Wistar rats are anesthetized and positioned in a stereotaxic apparatus for intranigral injections.
tasks.goal: to prepare animals for treatment and injections

tasks.title: Stress Induction
tasks.description: Animals are subjected to a 9-day variate stress paradigm, including restraint and forced swimming.
tasks.goal: to induce chronic stress in experimental groups

tasks.title: Corticosterone Measurement
tasks.description: Blood is collected from the heart of anesthetized rats to measure serum corticosterone levels.
tasks.goal: to assess stress response via corticosterone levels

tasks.title: Tissue Preparation for Immunohistochemistry
tasks.description: Brain sections are prepared from perfused animals for immunohistochemical analysis.
tasks.goal: to prepare tissue samples for immunohistochemical evaluation

tasks.title: Immunohistochemical Staining
tasks.description: Sections are incubated with primary and secondary antibodies to visualize specific proteins.
tasks.goal: to visualize target proteins in brain sections

tasks.title: Immunohistochemical Data Analysis
tasks.description: Quantitative analysis of immunostained sections is performed to assess protein expression.
tasks.goal: to analyze immunohistochemical data for protein expression

tasks.title: Real-Time RT-PCR
tasks.description: RNA is extracted from brain tissue and cDNA is synthesized for quantitative PCR analysis.
tasks.goal: to quantify gene expression levels in brain samples

tasks.title: Western Blot Analysis
tasks.description: Protein samples are prepared, separated by SDS-PAGE, and transferred to membranes for antibody detection.
tasks.goal: to detect specific proteins in brain tissue samples

tasks.title: Lipid Peroxidation Measurement
tasks.description: Lipid hydroperoxide levels are measured using a colorimetric assay.
tasks.goal: to assess oxidative stress in brain samples

tasks.title: Statistical Analysis
tasks.description: Data are analyzed using appropriate statistical methods to compare results across groups.
tasks.goal: to statistically evaluate experimental results

tasks.title: Mouse Vaccination
tasks.description: Vaccinate BALB/c mice with VRP-SARS-N or control VRP-GFP via intranasal or subcutaneous routes at 6-7 week intervals.
tasks.goal: to induce CD4+ T cell responses

tasks.title: Challenge with SARS-CoV
tasks.description: Challenge vaccinated mice with mouse-adapted SARS-CoV to assess protection and immune response.
tasks.goal: to evaluate vaccine efficacy against viral challenge

tasks.title: Memory CD4+ T Cell Depletion
tasks.description: Deplete memory CD4+ T cells in vaccinated mice prior to challenge to assess their role in protection.
tasks.goal: to determine the importance of memory CD4+ T cells in protection

tasks.title: T Cell Localization Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze the localization of N-specific CD4+ T cells in the airway, parenchyma, and vasculature using specific antibodies.

tasks.title: Cytokine Expression Assessment
tasks.description: Measure the expression of cytokines such as IFN-γ in the lungs of vaccinated mice after challenge.

tasks.title: Dendritic Cell Migration Analysis

tasks.goal: to determine the role of CD4+ T cells in enhancing dendritic cell migration

tasks.title: CD8+ T Cell Response Evaluation
tasks.description: Evaluate the frequency and functionality of CD8+ T cells in the lungs post-challenge.
tasks.goal: to assess the adaptive immune response to SARS-CoV

tasks.title: Cross-Reactivity Testing
tasks.description: Test the cross-reactivity of CD4+ T cells induced by VRP-MERS-N against SARS-CoV challenge.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the potential for cross-protection against different coronaviruses

tasks.title: Maintain C. elegans Strains
tasks.description: Culture C. elegans under standard conditions and synchronize through alkaline hypochlorite treatment to isolate eggs.
tasks.goal: to maintain and synchronize C. elegans strains

tasks.title: Construct Repair Template
tasks.description: Use SapTrap to construct the repair template for knock-in of the AID degron into the nhr-25 gene.
tasks.goal: to generate a repair template for gene editing

tasks.title: Microinject C. elegans
tasks.description: Inject synchronized N2 C. elegans with the repair template and Cas9 vector to facilitate gene editing.
tasks.goal: to perform microinjection for gene editing

tasks.title: Isolate Knock-ins
tasks.description: Isolate and verify knock-in junctions through PCR and backcrossing against wild-type N2 animals.
tasks.goal: to confirm successful gene editing

tasks.title: Perform Auxin Experiments
tasks.description: Transfer synchronized L1 larval stage animals to NGM agar plates with auxin treatments and controls.

tasks.title: Conduct Brood Size and Viability Assays
tasks.description: Evaluate brood size and viability by transferring L4 hermaphrodites to various MYOB plates and counting eggs laid.
tasks.goal: to measure reproductive success and viability

tasks.title: Perform RNAi Experiments
tasks.description: Construct RNAi targeting cul-1 and utilize feeding strains to silence specific genes in C. elegans.
tasks.goal: to investigate gene function through RNA interference

tasks.title: Score Anchor Cell Specification
tasks.description: Plate synchronized animals and assess the presence of anchor cells using DIC optics.
tasks.goal: to evaluate anchor cell specification

tasks.title: Score VPC Arrest
tasks.description: Transfer animals to auxin plates and assess vulval precursor cell divisions at specific developmental stages.
tasks.goal: to analyze VPC cell division dynamics

tasks.title: Image Acquisition
tasks.description: Capture images of C. elegans using various microscopy techniques for subsequent analysis.
tasks.goal: to obtain high-quality images for analysis

tasks.title: Image Processing and Analysis
tasks.description: Process and analyze acquired images using Fiji software to quantify fluorescence intensity and degradation.
tasks.goal: to quantify and analyze imaging data

tasks.title: Statistical Analysis
tasks.description: Perform statistical analysis to determine sample sizes and assess significance of experimental results.
tasks.goal: to validate experimental findings statistically

tasks.description: Use CRISPR-Cas9 to create specific mutations in the rad-51 and spo-11 genes, tagging them with GFP.

tasks.title: DSS Treatment of Mice
tasks.description: C57BL/6 mice are treated with 3% DSS in drinking water for 7 days under controlled conditions.
tasks.goal: to induce colonic inflammation in mice

tasks.title: Euthanasia and Tissue Collection
tasks.description: Mice are euthanized using CO2, and a small piece of proximal colon is collected for RNA extraction.
tasks.goal: to obtain colonic tissue for RNA analysis

tasks.title: RNA Extraction
tasks.description: Total RNA is isolated from the collected colonic tissues using TRIzol and assessed for integrity.
tasks.goal: to extract and assess RNA quality from colonic tissues

tasks.title: Lithium Chloride Purification
tasks.description: RNA is purified from polysaccharides using lithium chloride precipitation.
tasks.goal: to remove contaminants from RNA samples

tasks.title: cDNA Synthesis
tasks.description: cDNA is synthesized from purified RNA using the Maxima First-Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit.
tasks.goal: to convert RNA into cDNA for further analysis

tasks.title: Quantitative PCR (qPCR)
tasks.description: cDNA is quantified using qPCR with specific primers to measure gene expression levels.
key_materials: Maxima SYBR Green/ROX qPCR Master Mix
tasks.goal: to quantify gene expression from cDNA samples

tasks.title: Polymerase Activity Assay
tasks.description: The enzymatic activity of Taq DNA polymerase is measured using a fluorometric assay.
key_materials: EvaEZ™ Fluorometric Polymerase Activity Assay kit
tasks.goal: to assess the activity of DNA polymerase in the presence of DSS

tasks.title: Reverse Transcriptase Activity Assay
tasks.description: The activity of reverse transcriptase is measured using a fluorometric assay with a polyA RNA template.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the activity of reverse transcriptase in the presence of DSS

tasks.title: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) Experiment
tasks.description: SPR is performed to study the interaction between reverse transcriptase and RNA in the presence of DSS.
tasks.goal: to analyze binding interactions between molecules using SPR

tasks.title: Statistical Analysis
tasks.description: Data is analyzed using statistical methods to determine significance of results.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the statistical significance of experimental data

tasks.title: Cell Isolation from Synovial Fluid
tasks.description: Obtain plasma cells from the synovial fluid of a patient with anti-CCP-positive RA and isolate antibody-secreting cells using the fluorescent foci method.
tasks.goal: to isolate plasma cells and antibody-secreting cells

tasks.title: Sorting of B Cells
tasks.description: Sort single citrulline-specific B cells from the peripheral blood of RA patients using flow cytometry and an antigen-tetramer system.
tasks.goal: to obtain citrulline-specific B cells

tasks.title: Peptide ELISA
tasks.description: Perform peptide ELISAs to assess binding to citrulline- and arginine-containing peptides, including various proteins.
tasks.goal: to evaluate antibody binding to peptides

tasks.title: Full-length Protein ELISA
tasks.description: Conduct full-length protein ELISAs by coating plates with proteins, blocking, and incubating with antibodies and detection reagents.
tasks.goal: to assess antibody binding to full-length proteins

tasks.title: Extracellular Matrix Peptide Microarray
tasks.description: Synthesize and analyze a microarray of peptides covering extracellular matrix proteins and assess reactivity with antibodies.
tasks.goal: to identify antibody reactivity to a wide range of peptides

tasks.title: Western Blotting
tasks.description: Perform Western blot analyses on solubilized proteins, followed by incubation with antibodies and visualization.
tasks.goal: to detect specific proteins using antibodies

tasks.title: Sequence Logo Visualization
tasks.description: Analyze the flanking amino acids of posttranslational residues using the WebLogo application to generate consensus sequences.
tasks.goal: to visualize consensus peptide sequences

tasks.title: Statistical Analysis
tasks.description: Conduct statistical analyses to compare characteristics between ACPAs and non-ACPAs using appropriate tests.
tasks.goal: to determine statistical significance of experimental results

tasks.title: Isolation of iPS-DCregs
tasks.description: Isolate induced pluripotent stem-derived dendritic regulatory cells (iPS-DCregs) from the appropriate source.
tasks.goal: to obtain a pure population of iPS-DCregs

tasks.title: Characterization of iPS-DCregs
tasks.description: Assess the morphology and surface marker expression of iPS-DCregs to confirm their identity and functionality.
key_materials: antibodies for CD40, CD80, CD86, MHC class II
tasks.goal: to verify the characteristics of iPS-DCregs

tasks.title: Antigen Uptake Assay
tasks.description: Perform fluorescein isothiocyanate uptake tests with ovalbumin and dextran to evaluate the antigen uptake ability of iPS-DCregs.
tasks.goal: to determine the antigen uptake capacity of iPS-DCregs

tasks.title: Allogeneic Mixed Lymphocyte Reaction (MLR)
tasks.description: Set up an allogeneic MLR to evaluate the direct antigen-presenting regulatory function of iPS-DCregs.
key_materials: naive T cells from CBA mice
tasks.goal: to assess the immunosuppressive effect of iPS-DCregs on T cell proliferation

tasks.title: OVA-Specific MLR Setup
tasks.description: Establish an OVA-specific MLR to investigate the indirect antigen-presenting regulatory ability of iPS-DCregs.
key_materials: TCR transgenic mice OT-II and OT-I
tasks.goal: to evaluate the regulatory function of iPS-DCregs in T cell responses

tasks.title: In Vivo Regulatory Function Testing
tasks.description: Conduct a proliferation lymph node assay (PLNA) to test the in vivo regulatory function of iPS-DCregs.
tasks.goal: to assess the in vivo immunosuppressive effects of iPS-DCregs

tasks.title: Immunization of Mice with iPS-DCregs
tasks.description: Immunize CBA mice with iPS-DCregs and isolate spleen cells for further analysis.
tasks.goal: to generate Tregs in vivo through iPS-DCregs immunization

tasks.title: Secondary Immunization and Co-Culture
tasks.description: Co-culture isolated spleen cells with B6 BM-DCcons or BALB/c BM-DCcons for secondary immunization.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the effect of iPS-DCregs on T cell proliferation during secondary immunization

tasks.title: Cardiac Allograft Transplantation
tasks.description: Perform cardiac allograft transplantation in CBA mice pre-treated with iPS-DCregs to assess graft acceptance.
tasks.goal: to determine the effect of iPS-DCregs on allograft survival

tasks.title: Histological Analysis of Allografts
tasks.description: Analyze allograft tissues for lymphocyte infiltration and other histological changes post-transplantation.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the immune response in transplanted allografts

tasks.title: Cytokine and Treg Analysis
tasks.description: Measure the expression of cytokines and Treg markers in spleen cells and allografts.
tasks.goal: to assess the immunological changes induced by iPS-DCregs

tasks.title: Peptide Identification in Xylem Exudate
tasks.description: Collect xylem exudate from Arabidopsis and perform nano-liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (nano-LC–MS/MS) to identify peptides.
tasks.goal: to identify and confirm the presence of CLE2 peptide

tasks.title: Expression Analysis of CLE2
tasks.description: Conduct expression analysis of CLE2 in plants treated with the photosynthesis inhibitor DCMU or subjected to prolonged darkness.
tasks.goal: to determine the expression levels of CLE2 under low-carbon conditions

tasks.title: Generation of Mutant Lines
tasks.description: Use CRISPR/Cas9 technology to generate cle2cle3 double mutants and cle1-7 septuple mutants for functional analysis.
tasks.goal: to create mutant lines for studying CLE gene functions

tasks.title: Phenotypic Analysis of Mutants
tasks.description: Evaluate the sugar and starch contents in the roots and leaves of cle2, cle3, cle2cle3, and cle1-7 mutants.
tasks.goal: to assess the impact of CLE mutations on sugar metabolism

tasks.title: Gain-of-Function Analysis of CLE2
tasks.description: Conduct gain-of-function experiments using the CoYMV promoter to analyze the effects of ectopic expression of CLE2 on sucrose levels.
tasks.goal: to investigate the role of CLE2 in regulating sucrose levels

tasks.title: Application of Synthetic CLE2 Peptide
tasks.description: Apply synthetic CLE2 peptide to rosette leaves of Arabidopsis and measure the resulting sugar and starch contents after 24 hours.
tasks.goal: to evaluate the effect of CLE2 peptide on sucrose levels in plants

tasks.title: Grafting Experiments
tasks.description: Perform grafting of cle1-7 and WT plants to assess the influence of root genotype on SUC2 expression in leaves.
tasks.goal: to determine the effect of root-derived CLE peptides on leaf gene expression

tasks.title: Quantitative Expression Analysis of Sucrose-Related Genes
tasks.description: Analyze the expression levels of genes involved in sucrose transport, synthesis, and degradation in leaves and roots of various mutants.
tasks.goal: to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying sucrose regulation in mutants

tasks.title: Preparation of Neuronal Cultures
tasks.description: Cortical and hippocampal neurons are isolated from mouse embryos and cultured in a specific medium to promote neuronal growth.
tasks.goal: to establish high-density neuronal cultures

tasks.title: Transduction of Neurons
tasks.description: Neurons are transduced with GFP-expressing lentivirus at a specific multiplicity of infection to label the cells.
tasks.goal: to label neurons for subsequent analysis

tasks.title: Neuronal Treatment
tasks.description: Neurons are treated with FGFb and EGF for a short duration to stimulate growth and signaling pathways.
tasks.goal: to promote neuronal signaling and growth

tasks.title: MTT Assay for Viability
tasks.description: The MTT assay is performed to assess the viability of neuronal cultures by measuring absorbance after treatment with MTT.
tasks.goal: to evaluate neuronal cell viability

tasks.title: Protein Extraction and Quantification
tasks.description: Neurons are lysed to extract proteins, which are then quantified using the Bradford assay for further analysis.
tasks.goal: to prepare protein samples for analysis

tasks.title: Western Blotting
tasks.description: Proteins are separated by SDS-PAGE, transferred to a membrane, and probed with specific antibodies to detect target proteins.
tasks.goal: to identify and quantify specific proteins

tasks.title: Immunofluorescence Staining
tasks.description: Neurons are fixed and stained with antibodies to visualize specific proteins and assess mitochondrial superoxide content.
tasks.goal: to visualize and quantify protein expression and mitochondrial activity

tasks.title: Electrophysiological Recordings
tasks.description: Whole-cell patch clamp recordings are performed to assess neuronal electrical activity under controlled conditions.
tasks.goal: to measure neuronal excitability and synaptic activity

tasks.title: Data Analysis and Statistical Evaluation
tasks.description: Data from experiments are logged and analyzed using statistical software to determine significance and trends.
tasks.goal: to analyze and interpret experimental data
